Second, the anti-fabrication concern (concern:anti-fabrication, triggered_by='universal') requires that every component's owned_node_ids trace to packet-supplied prov identifiers; dist/ nodes carry no prov ref and the anti-fabrication gate emits a fabricated-node violation.
